iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. OpenFA Braccatian Morning Glory BR3A small spacecraft, required retrospective concept iteration1 of max3. Input is actual paletted legacy headings. Preserve the short compact asymmetrical axial craft: a pale-gold central spindle/neck, a small silver-grey terminal at one end, and a broad rose-copper flared rounded/conical terminal at the other, with the pale-gold bright collar at that broad end and a short rose tip beyond it. SIDE-VIEW total length about 2.3 to 2.8 times maximum height across the broad flared end, not an extremely thin pencil. Preserve the broad copper termination's silhouette across end-on legacy headings. Small-craft scale; no wings, cockpit bubble, new weapons, guessed exhaust flames, giant engine bells, antennas or insignia. Closed restrained end fittings rather than invented gun muzzles. Shared Braccatian worn copper/rose metal and pale ochre brass, small silver-grey tip. Fine isolated scratches, small scuffs/dents, grime at mechanical joins, sparse broad surface seams, no dense panel grid. Show one coherent three-quarter view plus a side view of exactly the same proportions, dark neutral studio background, no text or original pixel collage.
iterations.verdict: Retained: compact gold spindle with silver-grey tip opposite broad rose terminal, pale-gold collar and short rose end tip.

glb_visual_review: Imported GLB retains compact corrected section proportions, gold spindle, silver end fitting and opposite broad rose termination. Individual collar contours differ from concept but preserve the clearer legacy colour/silhouette constraints. Rougher alloy finish applied; no guessed mechanisms added.
